answer.answer: The dataset gives only one aggregated concentration summary (p10/median/p90) for the entire 2001–2012 Law et al. 2014 study, with no yearly breakdown to split into first-third vs last-third sampling periods. Without per-year data, no factor can be computed, so no conclusion about a rise in Pacific plastic can be drawn from this source.
